_comment: Copy this to config.local.json (gitignored) and paste your Discord webhook URLs. Point 'technology' at its own channel, or reuse the 'political' URL to fold tech into politics.

logging._comment: The disk logger. One JSON object per event, one file per run. Every key here is optional: leave the whole block out and these same defaults apply. 'dir' resolves relative to this config file. 'file_pattern' substitutes {date} {time} {pid} {run}. Levels are off | error | warn | info | debug. A run file rotates at 'max_file_bytes' and one run keeps at most 'max_files_per_run' files (the live one included); 'keep_run_files' is how many earlier runs stay in the directory. Webhook URLs and tokens are redacted before anything is written.

lock._comment: The headless runner's single-instance lock, which stops a second copy on this host from racing data/seen.json and posting every card twice. Every key is optional: leave the whole block out and these same defaults apply. The file sits in the directory 'seen_path' resolves into. The holder rewrites its heartbeat every 'beat_seconds'; a lock whose owner cannot be found in the task list counts as dead once its heartbeat is older than beat_seconds x missed_beats (90 s by default). 'read_tries' and 'read_retry_ms' cover a read that lands while the record is being rewritten.
